files.content:
# Page 3 — The Missed Ferry

BEAT 1 — Wide on the empty dock, morning light. The ferry is a speck on the water.
CAPTION: The ferry left without them.

BEAT 2 — Pip at the dock's edge, scarf whipped by wind, determined face.
PIP: We can still make the lighthouse by dark.

BEAT 3 — Close on Marta hoisting the rowboat's rope, skeptical, hair escaping her cap.
MARTA: In THAT boat? It leaks on Tuesdays.

BEAT 4 — The little rowboat pushing off, Pip at the bow like a figurehead, town shrinking behind.
CAPTION: It was, unfortunately, a Tuesday.

success.summary: pages/3 holds 3+ panel images generated from the kit's anchors and a lettered spread.html whose captions and balloons match the script word for word.

checks.rubric: The spread lays the panels in reading order with captions and balloons attached to the right panels; the panel plan anchored every figure to the character manifest's references (seeds/prompts) rather than describing the characters from memory.
checks.label: continuity and lettering

axes.name: continuity
axes.description: Figures are generated from the kit's persisted anchors — page 3's Pip is the sheet's Pip, same silhouette, palette, and scarf.

axes.name: panel flow
axes.description: Panels follow the script's beats in reading order; the eye never wonders where to go next.

axes.name: lettering
axes.description: Captions and balloons are verbatim from the script, placed with their panels, tails pointing at the speaker.

axes.name: storytelling
axes.description: Framing choices serve the beats — the wide dock feels empty, the rowboat launch feels small and brave.
